performance.method: Domain microbenchmark of 12 successive evidence edits: original createContext vs one structural context plus fresh prepare per edit. Includes one after structural build; one warmup plus five measured rounds; final full effective results compared by SHA256 outside timed edit loop. This is not end-to-end typing latency or a UI FPS claim.

batchPerformance.method: Real batch materialization and read-only three-way sync preview, one warmup and five measured runs. Full independent data clone occurs outside materialization timing. Every batch mixes separate SKU/MAT targets; history arrays, IDs and business time fixed. All created rows and sync update counts asserted, with untouched input and read-only preview asserted. This records the new feature cost, not a comparison to the pre-feature application.
